text: Konrad Curze could see the future. And it was always dark.
He grew up alone on Nostramo, a world that never saw the sun.
He hunted its criminals in the night, until the whole world feared him.
He led the Night Lords, and ruled through terror.
When his homeworld fell back into crime, he destroyed it.
He joined Horus. Then he saw his own death.
An assassin, sent by the Emperor.
Curze could have fled. Instead, he waited for her on his throne.
His last words: death is nothing, compared to vindication.
